title: Boop — Turn iMessage into a Personal AI Assistant (Open Source)
description:
Boop is a free open-source tool that turns your iMessage into a personal AI assistant. You text it like a person, and it does tasks, remembers context, and schedules automations. It runs on your own machine using your Claude or Codex subscription.
